text:
ravi: FYI we're seeing a persistent pattern in sa-east1: slots reported free but scheduler keeps failing small pods with 'taint mismatch' and then preempting helpers. looks like a taint age/propagation issue.

zoe: any recent infra changes? taint controller?

ravi: yes cluster-agent v4.5 bumped taint-propagation to 'eager' in the last deploy. timing shows node goes NotReady briefly, controller applies taint, then removes it but scheduler decisions in the window treat nodes as tainted.

infra-bot: deploy/cluster-agent v4.5 rolled by @zoe at 2026-06-20T09:12Z

oncall: impact: fragmented GPUs across racks in sa-east1, small-pod scheduling latency +1.2s, helper preempt spike ~6% for 30m.

ravi: sample events: ```
Normal 09:18:03 kubelet NodeNotReady node=sa1-rack4-n02 KubeletNotReady: heartbeat lost
Normal 09:18:07 taint-controller TaintAdded node=sa1-rack4-n02 key=node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute
Normal 09:18:09 scheduler FailedScheduling pod=helper-slim-77 0/36 nodes are available: 36 had taints the pod didn't tolerate.
Normal 09:18:12 taint-controller TaintRemoved node=sa1-rack4-n02
Normal 09:18:15 kubelet NodeReady node=sa1-rack4-n02 kubelet is now healthy
```

zoe: two quick ideas: 1) make scheduler ignore taints younger than 8s for packing-aware queues, or 2) change taint-controller to delay adding NoExecute until node ConfirmedUnready for 5s.

ravi: prefer 2 for correctness, but 1 is lower-risk short-term. also add metric taintAddLatency and taintAgeBeforeDecision.

oncall: temporary mitigation: applied scheduler flag packer.ignore-young-taints=8s to sa-east1 only. rolling restart of scheduler reduced helper preempts immediately.

zoe: opened INFRA-7620 with traces and recommended change to taint-controller. followups: add taintAgeHistogram, fragmentedGpuGauge_by_rack, and a canary that blocks cluster-agent rollout if transientTaintRate > 0.5% in 30m.

ravi: cost note: observed brief spot churn bump and ~0.18% bill delta for the hour. include in postmortem.

infra-bot: alert cleared: sa-east1 fragmented-gpus  duration 22m

oncall: monitoring green for 40m. reverting packer.ignore-young-taints after controller fix lands. thanks team :thumbsup:
